content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Evansville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Review PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Evansville professionals in manufacturing, logistics, and healthcare typically meet these benchmarks. Gather your transcripts and project documentation to verify you qualify before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our Evansville cohorts run on flexible schedules to fit working professionals. You'll earn the formal education hours PMI requires, taught by certified instructors who understand local industry contexts.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your PMP application directly to PMI and pay the exam fee. Granite PM Academy guides you through the documentation process. PMI will review your eligibility and grant authorization to sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests and study materials. Schedule your computer-based PMP exam at a Pearson VUE center in or near Evansville. Our instructors remain available to answer questions during your final review week.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) throughout a three-year renewal cycle to keep your PMP active. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses and workshops. Plan your ongoing learning strategy early to ensure continuous compliance with PMI requirements.
